notes: Model pilot (haiku arm; the same pole is tested independently by the other arm, pairing disclosed): this pole reads the held pole bonsai1/L13/N2535- (zeroing the anchor removes 1.00 of this pole's activation), from a batched edge measurement with 8 same-layer placebos. Label and all 16 sentences written by the Haiku 5.5 labeller from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + the edge hint) and one probe round of 8 sentences (none reused). An Opus gate checked rule-level items only and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Probes did not fire on the verbs: told, say and Officials stayed at 0.01 to 0.25. The passive near miss was thought stayed low at 0.04, but a singular forecaster sentence is a hard edge the test checks.
